newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo affiliates file for receivership.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo affiliates file for receivership.

text.p: Two affiliates of South Korea's troubled Hanbo Steel, Sang-A Pharmaceutical Co Ltd and Hanbo Energy Co, filed for court receivership on Wednesday, a Hanbo Group spokeman said.
Hanbo Steel, the flagship of Hanbo Group, and its unlisted affiliate Hanbo Corp applied for court protection on Tuesday.

A group of 61 South Korean banks and financial institutions with loans to Hanbo Steel have said it will support court receivership for Hanbo by suspending demands for debt repayment and resuming overdraft facilities.
The three affiliates of Hanbo Steel guaranteed loans to the country's second largest steelmaker, which defaulted on debt payments last week.
